The '''2020–21 Super League Greece''' was the 85th season of the [[Super League Greece]], the top Greek professional league for association football clubs, since its establishment in 1959. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] were the defending champions.

==Teams==
Fourteen teams competed in the league – the top twelve teams from the previous season, the play-off winner and one team promoted from the [[Super League Greece 2|Super League 2]]. The promoted team was [[PAS Giannina F.C.|PAS Giannina]], who returned to the first tier after a one-season absence.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.agonasport.com/agonasport-allnews/super-league-2-ends-in-cancellation|title=SUPER LEAGUE 2 ENDS IN CANCELLATION|date=2 June 2020|website=Agonasport.com|access-date=10 July 2020|archive-date=18 August 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200818123215/https://www.agonasport.com/agonasport-allnews/super-league-2-ends-in-cancellation|url-status=dead}}</ref> They replaced [[Panionios F.C.|Panionios]] who were relegated after 23 seasons in the top flight.

[[Apollon Smyrnis F.C.|Apollon Smyrnis]] were also promoted by virtue of winning the play-off round, which relegated [[Xanthi F.C.|Xanthi]] after 31 years.
